speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Let Fame, that all hunt after in their lyues.

speaker: (the archer)
text: Mind the butt, master. The arrow does not know your line.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I mind it. I am on the path, not on the mark.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Let Fame, that all hunt after in their lyues.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Again. Let Fame, that all hunt after in their lyues. There. It sits.

speaker: (the archer)
text: Then take it with you. I have another shaft.
